Home Lko. ... on 15 March, 2024

Author: Rajesh Singh Chauhan
Bench: Rajesh Singh Chauhan
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:23137
Court No. - 11
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 11745 of 2023
Applicant :- Mohamad Javed And 3 Others
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Mishra,Atul Verma,Mohammad Afsar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.
Heard Sri Rajesh Mishra, learned counsel for the petitioners as well as learned AGA for the State and Ms. Saroj Neelu Omkar, Advocate who has filed 'Vakalatnama' on behalf of opposite party no. 2,
same is taken on record.

This Court vide order dated 4.12.2023 directed the parties to file compromise deed before the court below concerned and the court below was directed to verify the contents and parties of the compromise deed.
In the present case, the sections involved are 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC & 3/4 D.P. Act.
Mohamad Javed And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ...

entities.text: Mohamad Javed And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In compliance of the aforesaid order, compromise deed was filed before the court below concerned and the same vide its report dated 12.12.2023 has verified the contents and parties of the compromise deed and submitted his report to the extent that the parties and contents of the compromise deed are genuine and they have entered into the compromise by free-will.
Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 has submitted that the parties in dispute are not interested to pursue the criminal case.
